NONE: B2 US also alternate An alternative plan or method is one that you can use if you do not want to use another one.

非傳統的；另類的

NONE: › energy from moving water, wind, the sun, and gas from animal waste
可替代能源；非傳統能源（指水力、風力、太陽能以及沼氣產生的能源）
